ð 1 in 250,000 Vexite Wrench âï¸ 1 in 400,000 A Mod Kit rolls one random mod onto an open socket of a Rigged (Power Core) item. Sockets open with the core level: 1 at L1, 2 at L4, 3 at L8, 4 at L10. Gathering, Artisan and Combat kits roll only their own family; a Universal Mod Kit rolls from every family that fits the item and is the only source of Efficient and Resonant. Using a kit on a full core replaces a mod of your choice â the old mod is destroyed. Rank odds per roll: I 60% Â· II 30% Â· III 10% .
